data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

My overall pick is **1Password if ease of use and team collaboration matter most; Bitwarden if value for money is the priority.**

A business password manager is worth paying for because you get more than secure storage: shared vaults, employee access controls, central administration, and the ability to revoke access when someone leaves.

## My top 4 recommendations

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall)

- Excellent user experience across desktop, mobile and browsers.
- Shared vaults with granular permissions.
- Security alerts and password health monitoring.
- Easy employee onboarding and offboarding.

**Price\:** US\$24.95/month for 10 users on Teams Starter Pack, billed annually. Business is US\$8.99/user/month. [1password.com](https://1password.com/pricing/business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[1password.com](https://1password.com/product/teams-small-business-password-manager?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Open-source platform.
- Unlimited shared collections.
- Centralised administration and event logs.
- SCIM directory provisioning.
- Enterprise option supports SSO and self-hosting.

**Price\:** US\$4/user/month for Teams, or US\$6 for Enterprise, billed annually. [bitwarden.com](https://bitwarden.com/pricing/business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[bitwarden.com](https://bitwarden.com/products/business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/pricing/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

- Good administrative controls.
- Shared team folders.
- Useful for businesses with stricter access requirements.
- Additional security and compliance capabilities.

**Best for\:** Teams with more complex security requirements.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Dashlane : un gestionnaire de mots de passe élégant et complet, mais trop avare - Les Numériques](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/66TJUMmYmc2uHzIsxHHiAx7hxRQ8alP8a248IQqZpKMw5qyY_k9MeFr4rutufsLjTYxUl32XmJycQKSNVtCaRTxRhBdFKuuN8SD7uZ8vs9JkSCZSzdZ2yIQm88TGjWCrg-h07fJdRP7X6VdOalsZe2e6fj_Ou1dMYyLIEbt_d4hajtzL8hVlKJz2qWk0Hm2z?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dashlane**

- Polished interface.
- Password health monitoring.
- Phishing protection and security alerts.
- Useful security reporting.

**Best for\:** Teams prioritising credential risk monitoring.

[Dashlane business plans](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

## What I'd compare before choosing

| Feature | Why it matters |
|--------|--------|
| Shared vaults | Share company credentials safely |
| Access permissions | Restrict sensitive accounts |
| Employee offboarding | Revoke access immediately |
| 2FA support | Protect master accounts |
| Audit logs | See important account activity |
| Recovery | Avoid losing access if an admin leaves |


I'd also recommend enforcing MFA for everyone and never sharing one employee's personal vault.

## My recommendation

If I were setting up a small business today\:

- **1Password\:** Best if you want something easy for everyone to adopt.
- **Bitwarden\:** Best if you want to keep costs down without sacrificing important security features.

## A couple of questions to narrow it down

**1\. How many people are on your team?**
